Build prompt

Rebuild this animation 1:1: Swiggy's DineCash hero - a 3D hexagonal rupee token materializes on a mint canvas, then gives way to two hands holding phones at the edges with coins looping along an arc between them, above a QR scan card.

## Integration
Integration: stack-agnostic spec - springs given as stiffness/damping, timed motions as duration + curve; map every value to your framework and animation library of choice.

## Scene
"Receive DineCash" screen on a mint-green field with a faint radial sunburst. Hero zone occupies the top half; below it sit the title ("Receive DineCash & save more on this bill!") and a white card with "Ask friends to scan the QR code" and a QR code.

## Motion spec
Pattern: looping hero - token pop-in, then a peer-to-peer coin arc cycle.
- Entrance: the 3D hex token scales 0 -> 1 with a fast spin (rotateY 180deg, 500ms, spring ~300/20), hovering with a soft drop shadow and a subtle float bob (+/- 6px, 2.4s).
- Swap: the token fades and shrinks (300ms) as two hands holding phones slide in from the left and right edges (translate 60px -> 0, 400ms, ease-out).
- Coin loop: 4-6 rupee coins travel along a shallow arc from the left phone to the right phone (1.6s per coin, ease-in-out, staggered 300ms, scale 0.7 -> 1 -> 0.7 along the path), looping indefinitely.
- Title and QR card stay static throughout; only the hero zone animates.

## Calibration
- The arc must read as money in flight between two people - keep the coin path flat and shallow, not a rainbow.
- The token's spin is glossy and physical (metal shading), the coins are flat and graphic.

## Reduced motion
Token fades in (200ms); hands appear static with coins frozen mid-arc; no looping travel.

## Don't miss
- Hands enter from opposite edges and hold phones facing each other.
- The sunburst rays behind the hero rotate very slowly (~60s per revolution) - barely perceptible, but present.
